messages:
Nina (PM): Quick sync: three incoming asks — hard EU residency, APAC latency SLA, and a guaranteed fallback behavior. Need a compact plan we can present to customers.
Rafi (Eng): TL;DR: soft-affinity + SLA tiers is fastest. Hard residency requires reservation slices and admission controller; big utilization hit.
Priya (Arch): Agreed. Suggest two-phase: Phase A = policy templates + simulator + soft-affinity. Phase B = reservation lanes + migration tooling.
Diego (Sales): Customers prefer clear product names. I'll avoid selling 'no-egress' until Legal signs off. Can we offer "Residency Pilot (soft)" first?
Zoe (Legal): We can support pilot language that specifies fallback ordering and that absolute no-egress requires hard reservations + attestation (KMS region, audit logs).
Liam (SRE): Ops note: hard reservations increase blast radius. Need automatic evacuation playbook and an alarm when reservation pressure > 75%. Also require a chaos run during pilot.
Nina (PM): Launch criteria for Phase A: 1) policy DSL + template catalog merged, 2) simulator accuracy within 15% on capacity, 3) telemetry panels for percent-served-in-preferred-region, 4) two pilot tenants signed.
Rafi (Eng): API sketch for Phase A: route_policy { tenant_id: "T-42" template: "residency-soft" prefer_region: "eu-west-1" dry_run: true } Dry-run returns placement prediction and fallback likelihood.
Priya (Arch): Telemetry checklist: per-tenant region histogram, prefix/KV cross-region miss rate, fallback count, reservation utilization for Phase B. These are gating metrics.
Diego (Sales): Pricing sketch: (A) soft pilot free for first 3 months, (B) residency surcharge per-request for GA, (C) reservation monthly fee for hard lanes. I'll draft numbers after simulator results.
Zoe (Legal): Include explicit fallback SLA tiers: primary region SLO, paired-region SLO, and global fallback SLO with expected latency deltas and customer opt-in for emergency cross-region.
Liam (SRE): Ops acceptance for Phase A canary: 48h ramp, <3 P0/P1 incidents, automated rollback on increased cross-region error rate or >20% cache miss.
Rafi (Eng): Dev plan: sprint 0 spike (2w) for simulator assumptions, sprint 1 DSL + dry-run API, sprint 2 metrics emission + dashboard, sprint 3 pilot support. Need 2 engs + 0.5 PM.
Priya (Arch): Long-term: policy-compiler that outputs capacity/cost impact per template. That feeds pricing and admission decisions for hard reservations.
Nina (PM): Action items: Rafi 1 simulator spike + draft API (due EOW). Priya 1 telemetry spec + template samples (3 days). Liam 1 ops runbook draft + chaos plan (1 week). Diego 1 pricing sketch + pilot outreach (3 days). Zoe 1 review pilot contract language (2 days).
ops-bot: Reminder: please add the roadmap PR link to #release-war-room before EOD Thu. :bell:
Diego (Sales): ack, will put draft pricing in the PR.
Rafi (Eng): I'll post the spike doc and assumptions to this thread when ready.
Nina (PM): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after spikes to lock quarter commitments.
